items.title: Tom Welling's "Hello, NYCC" skyline photo shows more than the view
items.summary: The Smallville star posted a New York hotel-window view to his Instagram Story ahead of Comic Con, not noticing his nude reflection in the glass; it stayed up about 10 hours and screenshots spread with millions of views. Fans made "POV: you're a tourist and see Tom Welling at his hotel window" Reels, and co-star Michael Rosenbaum posted a parody window selfie holding a "PERVERTS" sign. Welling reposted it and commented "Came for the sights."
items.author: @garfielwds

items.title: "Calm down, Yacob": Khloe Kardashian reads a teacher's DMs on TV
items.summary: On The Kardashians season premiere, Khloe recalled leaving a flirty "How was your day?" comment on a high school teacher's Instagram, then read his unanswered DMs aloud and told him, "Calm down, Yacob... please, get a J." Viewers called it a mean roast, and the teacher answered with a deadpan classroom TikTok saying he gets roasted by high schoolers every day.

items.title: Shopper spots "Nazi salutes" in a Barbie box's cheering crowd
items.summary: A mom filmed a gymnastics Barbie from Mattel's "You Can Do Anything" line at CVS and zoomed in on the illustrated crowd, arguing that the spectators' raised arms looked like Nazi salutes; she captioned it with a "heil-y disappointed" pun. Commenters split between calls to boycott Mattel and people pointing out that many of the figures were cheering with both arms up, and Mattel did not respond.
items.author: @Tr00peRR
